title: Faithfulness
description: Faithfulness means keeping your word and staying steady even when it's inconvenient — one of God's own core traits, and one he grows in us.

waypoints.title: Steady and True
waypoints.body: God has never once broken a promise, even when his people were unfaithful to him over and over. His faithfulness is the foundation we can build our own on.

waypoints.title: Someone Faithful
waypoints.body: Who is someone faithful in your life -- who always keeps their promises? Thank them this week.
